ideas.name: Forward Discount Currency Carry
ideas.claim: Currencies can be sorted monthly by their one-month forward discounts; a carry portfolio goes long the highest-interest-rate basket and short the lowest.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.

rules.market: Currencies against USD; the paper includes a developed-country sample as well as a broader sample.
rules.entry: Sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount. Go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest.
rules.exit: Rebalance portfolios at the end of every month.
rules.filters: The paper excludes specified observations with large covered interest parity failures.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average excess returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency baskets.
